title: VLMShield: Efficient and Robust Defense of Vision-Language Models against Malicious Prompts
abstract: arXiv:2604.06502v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face significant safety vulnerabilities from malicious prompt attacks due to weakened alignment during visual integration. Existing defenses suffer from efficiency and robustness. To address these challenges, we first propose the Multimodal Aggregated Feature Extraction (MAFE) framework that enables CLIP to handle long text and fuse multimodal information into unified representations. Through empirical analysis of MAFE-extracted features, we discover distinct distributional patterns between benign and malicious prompts. Building upon this finding, we develop VLMShield, a lightweight safety detector that efficiently identifies multimodal malicious attacks as a plug-and-play solution. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance across multiple dimensions, including robustness, efficiency, and utility. Through our work, we hope to pave the way for more secure multimodal AI deployment. Code is ava

translated_title: VLMShield：针对恶意提示的视觉语言模型高效且鲁棒的防御
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）由于在视觉整合过程中对齐能力减弱，面临来自恶意提示攻击的重大安全漏洞。现有防御方法在效率和鲁棒性方面存在不足。为了解决这些挑战，我们首先提出了多模态聚合特征提取框架，使CLIP能够处理长文本并将多模态信息融合为统一的表示。通过对MAFE提取特征的实证分析，我们发现良性提示与恶意提示之间存在截然不同的分布模式。基于这一发现，我们开发了VLMShield，一种轻量级安全检测器，作为一种即插即用的解决方案，能够高效识别多模态恶意攻击。大量实验表明，该方法在鲁棒性、效率和实用性等多个维度上均展现出卓越性能。我们希望通过这项工作为更安全的多模态AI部署铺平道路。代码已发布。
tldr: 该论文提出MAFE多模态特征提取框架和轻量级安全检测器VLMShield，利用良性与恶意提示之间的分布差异，以即插即用方式高效且鲁棒地检测针对视觉语言模型的多模态恶意攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the MAFE feature extraction framework and a lightweight plug-and-play safety detector VLMShield, which leverages distinct distributional patterns between benign and malicious prompts to efficiently and robustly detect multimodal malicious attacks on vision-language models.
